display.purpose: Hero headlines only — the largest voice on the page, used once per section.

title.purpose: Card titles, modal headers, subsection headings.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, descriptions, reviews — readable at length.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, categories, badges — small but assertive, always uppercase.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: Structural base for glass panels. Gives frosted surfaces weight.

shadows.name: neon-glow
shadows.purpose: Purple halo for primary interactions — nav scroll, card hover, CTA emphasis.

shadows.name: pink-glow
shadows.purpose: Pink halo for secondary interactions — wishlist, quick-view, active nav states.

shadows.name: gold-glow
shadows.purpose: Warm halo for value signals — cart badge, star ratings, price highlights.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Electric Violet gradient with glow-on-hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8A2BE2, #FF4FD8); color: #FAFAFA; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255,79,216,0.55), 0 0 60px rgba(255,79,216,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255,79,216,0.55), 0 0 60px rgba(255,79,216,0.25); outline: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent glass with subtle hover glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #FAFAFA; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255,79,216,0.55), 0 0 60px rgba(255,79,216,0.25); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255,79,216,0.55); outline: none; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06), rgba(255,255,255,0.02)); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 24px; padding: 12px; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 500ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255,79,216,0.55), 0 0 60px rgba(255,79,216,0.25); } .ds-card-image { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1/1; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-card-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 700ms; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-image img { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-card-body { padding: 12px 0 0; } .ds-card-category { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: oklch(0.75 0.04 305); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-price { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFD166, #FF4FD8); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }

components.css: .ds-navbar { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 50; padding: 16px; transition: padding 300ms; } .ds-navbar.scrolled { padding: 8px; } .ds-navbar-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(137,43,226,0.659), rgba(255,79,217,0.599)); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,79,217,0.49); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } .ds-navbar.scrolled .ds-navbar-inner { box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255,79,216,0.55), 0 0 60px rgba(255,79,216,0.25); } .ds-navbar-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; color: #FAFAFA; text-decoration: none; } .ds-navbar-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8A2BE2, #FF4FD8); border-radius: 12px; animation: pulse-glow 3s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-navbar-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-navbar-links a { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.75 0.04 305); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms, background 200ms; } .ds-navbar-links a:hover { color: #FAFAFA; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }

narrative.overview:
Galaxy Store is a digital cosmos where gaming culture meets galaxy aesthetics — bold, unapologetic, and culture-native. The system is playful and immersive: every surface should feel like stepping into a curated universe, not browsing a catalog. Deep space purples form the void; electric neon accents pulse through it like living light. Glassmorphism gives components weightless transparency, while colored glow halos create depth without heavy shadows.

The palette is cosmic in character — deep space purple as the infinite backdrop, electric violet and hot pink as the neon pulse, and warm gold as the premium highlight. Typography is bold and confident, with Poppins at heavy weights driving every heading. Spacing is generous and rhythmic, with generous section gaps creating breathing room between content blocks.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: the deep purple void (#120018) is the constant canvas
Neon pulse: purple (#9835fd) and pink (#FF4FD8) as primary energy
Gold warmth: amber (#FFD166) as premium highlight and trust signal
Glassmorphism: frosted translucent surfaces with backdrop blur
Glow halos: colored light defines depth, not traditional shadows
Bold confidence: extra-bold headings, generous spacing, unapologetic presence

rules.name: The Neon Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (Electric Violet) and secondary accent (Cosmic Pink) each appear on ≤15% of any given screen. Their scarcity is what makes them electric. Overuse kills the glow.

rules.name: The Gold Trust Rule
rules.body: Solar Gold is reserved for value signals: prices, ratings, and trust indicators. It never decorates; it always communicates value.

rules.name: The Extrabold Heading Rule
rules.body: All headings are weight 800. No heading uses a lighter weight. The cosmos speaks in bold.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Section eyebrows and category labels are always uppercase with 0.15em tracking. They are whispers before the headline shouts.

rules.name: The Section Breathing Rule
rules.body: Every major section gets 80px (mt-20) of vertical space above it. The heading gets 32px below it. This rhythm creates the cosmic breathing room.

rules.name: The Glow-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Components are flat at rest. Glows appear only as a response to state: hover, focus, scroll, or active selection. The cosmos is calm until you touch it.

rules.name: The Rounded Everything Rule
rules.body: Every container, button, input, badge, and card uses rounded corners. The minimum radius is 12px (rounded-xl). Sharp corners do not exist in this universe.

dos: Do use the neon gradient (purple→pink) for primary CTAs and brand moments — it is the signature.
Do apply glow halos only on interaction (hover, focus, active) — never at rest.
Do use Solar Gold for prices, ratings, and trust signals — it breaks the neon duopoly.
Do keep glass surfaces semi-transparent with backdrop blur — opacity is what makes them alive.
Do use extra-bold (800) for all headings — the cosmos speaks in bold.
Do maintain 80px vertical spacing between major sections — breathing room is non-negotiable.
Do use uppercase + wide tracking for eyebrows and labels — they whisper before the headline shouts.
donts: Don't use neon accents on more than 15% of any screen — scarcity creates the electric effect.
Don't add shadows without a colored glow — a zero-offset dark shadow is dead weight in this system.
Don't use sharp corners (radius below 12px) on any component — the universe is rounded.
Don't place gradient text on dark backgrounds — emphasis comes from weight and gold color, not gradient fills.
Don't use gray for secondary text on colored surfaces — tint it from the surface hue or use muted-foreground.
Don't apply glassmorphism to small inline elements — glass is for surfaces and containers, not spans.
